clauses.text: Materials shall be got approved from the Engineer-in- Charge before use at site.
Any damages done to the building during the execution of work shall be made good for which nothing extra shall be paid on any account & to the entire satisfaction of Engineer-in- Charge.
No T&P shall have issued by the department.
Nothing extra shall be paid on account of cartage.
Contractor should employ well trained technical staff on carried out the work.
Contractor is responsible for safety of staff and installation during carrying out the work.
The contractor should give warranty for One year for the parts replaced/installed.
Unserviceable dismantle material received from the work shall credited to the contractor.
